english.text: If I ______ you, I would definitely accept the offer without any hesitation.
english.annotation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 动词用 were
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: I wish I ______ harder when I was young enough to change my future.
english.annotation: wish 后的虚拟语气，与过去事实相反
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: This is the old house ______ we lived for almost ten years during our childhood.
english.annotation: 定语从句先行词在从句中作状语，应该用关系副词
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: ______ he will come to the conference tomorrow is still unknown to all of us.
english.annotation: 主语从句的引导词 whether 和 if 用法区别
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: The news ______ our team had won the championship spread quickly across campus.
english.annotation: 同位语从句和定语从句分不清，that 和 which 用法混淆
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: By the time we arrived at the theatre, the performance ______ already ______.
english.annotation: 主句是过去时，从句应该用过去完成时，时态判断错
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: Neither the students nor the teacher ______ aware of the change in schedule.
english.annotation: 主谓一致的就近原则忘了
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: ______ from the top of the hill, the city looks absolutely magnificent at night.
english.annotation: 现在分词和过去分词作状语，逻辑主语判断错
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: He clearly remembered ______ the door before leaving the office that evening.
english.annotation: remember to do 和 remember doing 的区别，动名词用法
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: All things ______, the plan seems quite reasonable and worth trying.
english.annotation: 独立主格结构没掌握，非谓语作状语混淆
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: 四级听力长对话第三题，问的是说话人预定的时间和价格。
english.annotation: 录音里的数字信息因为连读弱读没听清，细节题选错
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: 六级听力短文第二篇，问这篇短文的主旨大意是什么。
english.annotation: 只抓住了中间的场景词，没听开头和结尾的总结句，主旨题选错
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: 仔细阅读第二篇第三题：What is the author's attitude towards the new technology?
english.annotation: 推理判断题，需要根据上下文推断作者态度，我直接选了原文细节
english.subject: 大学英语

english.text: 完形填空第八题：前后两句是转折关系，需要选择合适的逻辑关系词。
